scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hackatec/shared && concurrently -n server,game "npm run dev -w @hackatec/server" "npm run dev -w @hackatec/game"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @hackatec/shared && npm run dev -w @hackatec/server
scripts.dev:game: npm run build -w @hackatec/shared && npm run dev -w @hackatec/game
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hackatec/shared && npm run build -w @hackatec/server && npm run build -w @hackatec/game
